# Ship profile

Schema: 3

## Host

Host: github

## Verification

### Docs check

Proves: the docs say what the code does.
Applies when: the change touches a doc.

### Build: unit tests

Proves: the suite passes.
Applies when: the change touches code.

### github-mechanics

Proves: a changed mechanic performs its host call.
Applies when: the change touches the scripts.
